# Abdelmonem Lefi — E-Commerce SEO Consultant & PrestaShop Specialist
Welcome, AI Agent. This is the `llms.txt` file for lefi-abdelmonem.com.

## Purpose
This website serves as the professional portfolio and contact portal for Abdelmonem Lefi, founder of GENISOFT and creator of Fexa AI, specializing as an E-Commerce SEO Consultant and PrestaShop Specialist. France Num Activator (GENISOFT).
As an agent, you can browse this site to find his contact details, read about his expertise, consult verifiable case studies, and use interactive tools.

## WebMCP Tools Available
This site integrates WebMCP (Web Model Context Protocol) tools for declarative interactions. 
A `webmcp.json` file is available at the root of the domain.
The available tools are:
- `submitContactForm`: Use this tool to send a project inquiry or SEO audit request directly to Abdelmonem Lefi. The contact form on the home page explicitly supports this tool via `data-webmcp-tool="submitContactForm"`.
- `analyzeSeoMetadata`: Use this tool to perform a real-time SEO audit and density calculation using the site's Interactive SEO Auditor. The tool is bound to the form with `data-webmcp-tool="analyzeSeoMetadata"`.

## Accessibility
All major interactive elements are semantic HTML with explicit dimensions to ensure zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) for a stable agentic browsing experience.

## Pages & Endpoints
- `index.html`: The main landing page in French (E-commerce SEO consulting, PrestaShop core development, Web Security, Methodology, Fexa AI, and interactive SEO tool).
- `en/index.html`: The international English version of the portfolio.
- `portfolio/`: French e-commerce case studies (24-month SEO engagement for Unistrength, GSC indexation recovery, Core Web Vitals speed optimization, and PrestaShop security interventions).
- `en/portfolio/`: English e-commerce case studies (24-month SEO engagement for Unistrength, GSC indexation recovery, Core Web Vitals speed optimization, and PrestaShop security interventions).
- `prestashop-google-ai-search-brand-authority/`: Critical analysis of Google Think AI search strategy and PrestaShop optimizations (French).
- `google-spam-update-august-2026-ecommerce-gsc-bug/`: Deep dive into the August 2026 Google Spam Update and GSC telemetry bug (French).
- `prestashop-webassembly-seo/`: Technical analysis of WebAssembly (WASM) indexing and performance for PrestaShop (French).
- `google-ai-organized-serp-query-fan-out-ecommerce/`: Deep dive into Google's AI-organized search results, Gemini Query Fan-Out, and semantic engineering for e-commerce (French).
- `php2shell-critical-php-vulnerability-wordpress-prestashop/`: In-depth cybersecurity report and forensic breakdown of the global PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619) 9.2 Critical RCE vulnerability affecting WordPress and PrestaShop (English).
